title: HDB Shop Rental Trends and Efforts to Keep Rents Affordable
what_it_is: HDB Shop Rental Trends and Efforts to Keep Rents Affordable

sections.label: HDB shop rent questions
sections.summary: Questions ask for average rents for medical facility units tendered by HDB, updates on keeping HDB shop rents affordable, and HDB shop sale and rental numbers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development for each of the past five years, including 2025 to date, what is the average rent per square metre and average rent quantum for commercial units successfully tendered out by HDB that year for medical facilities (i) island-wide (ii) within existing HDB blocks and (iii) within new BTO developments, respectively.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) whether an update can be provided on HDB’s efforts to keep the rent of HDB shops affordable, in particular those selling cooked food or providing medical services; and (b) whether HDB is exploring ways to moderate rental increases in high-rent areas, including by increasing the supply of HDB-owned shops.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) as of August 2025, how many HDB shops are (i) sold and (ii) rented out directly by HDB respectively; (b) how many HDB shops which have been sold have a remaining lease of less than 10 years, as of August 2025; and (c) whether the recent steep rise in the rent of privately held HDB rental shops is due to a shortage in supply of HDB shops.

sections.label: Number of HDB shops
sections.summary: As of August 2025, there are around 15,500 HDB shops in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As of August 2025, there are around 15,500 HDB shops in Singapore.

sections.label: Rents unchanged in most shops
sections.summary: Under this approach, rents in 90% of HDB rental shops have not increased in the last five years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Under this approach, rents in 90% of HDB rental shops have not seen an increase in rents in the last five years.

sections.label: Average rent per square foot
sections.summary: Average rent per square foot was $10.40 in 2020, $10 in 2021, $16.80 in 2022, $17.50 in 2023, $22.70 in 2024 and $28.50 in the first half of 2025.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The average rent per square foot was $10.40 in 2020, $10 in 2021, $16.80 in 2022, $17.50 in 2023, $22.70 in 2024, and $28.50 in the first half of 2025.

sections.label: Bartley Beacon GP clinic tender
sections.summary: The first PQM tender awarded to a GP clinic in Bartley Beacon had an awarded rent of $16.70 per square foot.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: For the first PQM tender awarded to a GP clinic in Bartley Beacon, the awarded rent was $16.70 per square foot, which is lower than the average awarded bid of $35.50 per square foot for designated GP clinic tenders in new housing projects awarded in the last three years.

sections.label: Sublet rent data collection
sections.summary: Sublet rent is an area of concern, and data between master tenant and sublet rent is not collected, though it may be furnished to IRAS.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the issue of sublet rent, indeed, that is an area of concern.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Per my main reply, unfortunately, at this stage, we do not collect the data of the rents between the master tenant and the sublet rent, though there would be instances where the data is actually furnished to the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS), because they have to pay stamp duties on rental leases.

sections.label: Prioritising essential trades for intervention
sections.summary: MND may selectively acquire privately-held HDB shops, considering whether the product or service is essential, such as cooked food.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
sentences.text: Can I just check: will MND be open to prioritising trades, where the cost of rental are leading to a much higher cost of living implications, for example, cooked food, so that interventions can be done sooner than later, given that that is a pressing concern on many Singaporeans' minds?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I did mention in my main reply that we will look at the option of selectively acquiring privately-held HDB shops, if necessary, and definitely, one of the considerations would be whether or not the product and service is essential.

sections.label: HDB acquiring shops for essential services
sections.summary: For essential food and medical services with suboptimal supply, HDB would look into selectively acquiring shops to increase supply and options.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Tenants make their business decisions, but I think that when it comes to essential services, specifically in the areas of food and medical service, we will take a more critical look at it, especially where we deem that the supply in an area is less than what would be optimal, then HDB would look into potentially, selectively, acquiring shops so that overall supply goes up and that there are more options for residents in that area.

sections.label: Acquiring high-priced sold shops
sections.summary: Acquiring a sold shop already transacted at a high price is not a good use of taxpayers' money.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: If we are to look at acquiring the sold shop, which is already transacted at a high price, I do not think that that is a good use of taxpayers' money.

sections.label: Publishing information on cost pressures
sections.summary: Publication of this information would give a good indication of cost pressures affecting Singaporeans on the ground.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Can I suggest to the Senior Minister of State that publication of this information would give, short of being a canary in the coal mine, a good indication of what is the situation involving some of the cost pressures that affect Singaporeans on the ground?

sections.label: Intervening in imperfect markets cautiously
sections.summary: Where data shows market imperfections, possible interventions will be looked at, but boundaries should not be overstepped given the commercial transaction.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: After we look at that data, where we know that there are imperfections in the market, where possible, we will look at how to potentially intervene.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But I would just caution that we might not want to overstep the boundaries, because fundamentally there is a commercial transaction between the master tenant and the sublet tenant.
